title: The Tool-Use Revolution — AI Learns to Use a Computer

panels.prompt: A dramatic visual metaphor: a brilliant glowing figure (representing AI) sits inside a sealed glass room, radiant with intelligence but isolated. Through a small slot in the glass wall, someone passes in a telephone, a toolbox, and a ring of keys. The figure's eyes light up with recognition and excitement as it reaches for the tools. Outside the glass, the real world is visible — terminals, files, code scrolling. The atmosphere shifts from constraint to possibility. Comic book style, warm editorial illustration with ink lines and watercolor washes, violet (#9F7AEA) glow inside the glass room, warm golden light on the tools

panels.text: The third leap changed everything: tool use. A language model is a text generator. It cannot read files, run commands, or check whether its code works. It is a brain in a jar — brilliant, but disconnected from the world.

panels.text: In June 2023, OpenAI introduced function calling for GPT-3.5 and GPT-4. The Toolformer paper (Feb 2023) showed LLMs could learn when to use tools. Anthropic introduced tool use for Claude models in early 2024, generally available with Claude 3 in March 2024. Tool use became a universal pattern.

panels.prompt: A cracking glass wall with brilliant light pouring through the cracks. On the far side of the wall, a glowing AI entity reaches through the cracks to touch a real terminal keyboard. The wall is labeled 'The barrier between thinking and doing'. The cracks spread from where the hands touch the glass. July 2023 date floating in the background. Dramatic lighting, violet and gold energy at the fracture points. Comic book style, warm editorial illustration with ink lines and watercolor washes

panels.text: In July 2023, OpenAI released Code Interpreter for ChatGPT. For the first time, a mainstream AI product could write Python code and run it in a sandboxed environment, see the output, and iterate. The wall between “thinking” and “doing” had cracked open.

Auto-GPT: The Mosaic Browser of AI Agents. In March/April 2023, an open-source project called Auto-GPT went explosively viral on GitHub. It tried to chain GPT-4 calls into a fully autonomous agent. In practice, it got stuck in loops and burned through API credits. But it captured the world’s imagination about what autonomous AI could become — the crude but visionary prototype that proved mass appetite for autonomous AI.

A white speech bubble with black outline above. Inside the bubble the text reads: "Not just chatting. Actually doing things. An agent." panels.bubble_text: Not just chatting. Actually doing things. An agent.
panels.speaker: AGENTBOT

panels.text: Tool use is the moment AI stopped being an oracle and started being a worker. An oracle answers questions. A worker takes actions. The difference is not intelligence — it is agency.
Tool use gave AI hands. But hands alone don't make a worker. A worker needs a plan — think, try, observe, repeat. In October 2022, a graduate student at Princeton had already written the playbook.
